_warning: TOKEN TOTALS BELOW ARE WRONG. They are placeholders, not measurements. AI WAS used: 6 LLM subagents performed semantic extraction over 34 documents/images (357 nodes, 818 edges, 18 hyperedges). The host Task tool did not expose each subagent's `usage` field, so the chunk files kept their input_tokens/output_tokens = 0 placeholders and this file summed them.
